inferences.statement: A second modern CreatePlan invocation with a new toolCallId, including omitted name, selects a new URI rather than updating latest plan.
The current BYOK description advising complete revised plan plus omitted name cannot select an existing file through the current native query handler.
Adding edit tool advertisement alone without a mode-aware path guard would omit a native permission boundary.

unknowns: No reproduction steps in issue screenshot; cannot know exact original Cursor/client/build or whether the file was selected/attached in that case.
No direct CreatePlan target URI input in examined factory/query; file edits take model-selected path from returned URI/user context. No full audit of how context advertises existing plan URIs.

Installed native name-field description still mentions first-call-only/stable naming, but actual factory description and consumers generate new identity for new calls; do not use field description alone as behavior evidence.
